s01.h1: Train Your Sales Team to Sell in 3D, Not Brochures
s01.subheadingBodyCopy: Saudi trainers coach your sales team in person and online, working with your sales director on showroom hardware, remote showcases and masterplan storytelling.

s02.h2: In-Person and Online Coaching for Frontline Sales Teams
s02.subheadingBodyCopy: Sales teams stop using 3D tools they haven't been trained on. Manzili works with your sales director to run hands-on workshops and online certification that turn sales consultants into confident project storytellers.
s02.block01Body: Hands-on coaching on your actual showroom equipment. Consultants learn to navigate touch tables, run LED wall presentations and pace a walkthrough, so they stay confident and keep eye contact in high-stakes VIP meetings.
s02.block02Body: A structured playbook for presenting to out-of-town and international buyers over video calls. Consultants learn co-browsing, how to orient buyers in the virtual masterplan, and fast digital follow-up that qualifies intent at a distance.
block02Features: Guide remote buyers through the 3D web platform
Answer layout and view questions on calls
Send tailored unit links straight after the call
s02.block03Body: A presentation structure that starts with Vision 2030 and regional connectivity, moves through neighborhood amenities and ends with the unit's views, privacy and long-term value.
block03Features: Links the big picture to unit value
Arabic and English, tuned for Saudi buyers

s03.h2: How Sales Enablement Speeds Up Off-Plan Sales
s03.card01Body: Consultants use the 3D tools as their main presentation instrument, replacing paper brochures and WhatsApp PDFs.
s03.card02Body: A standard remote showcase routine lets your team present masterplans and secure reservations from buyers across the GCC and beyond.
s03.card03Body: Structured storytelling anchors buyers in the masterplan's lifestyle value, so consultants can hold their price per square meter and sell premium unit types.

s04.subheadingBodyCopy: Built with your sales leadership, the modules train in-house consultants and external broker networks to sell the same way.
row1: Touch table and LED wall presentation
Confident use of tech in VIP meetings
row3: Buyers who can verify views and layout

s05.q1: How are the sales enablement programs delivered?
s05.a1: Through in-person workshops in your sales center and structured online coaching, led by Saudi trainers. Showroom consultants, remote sales reps and external brokers all train to the same standard.
s05.q2: How do you work with our sales director and commercial team?
s05.a2: From pre-launch planning onward. We align coaching with your sales targets, phased pricing and CRM workflow, and give your sales director floor-adoption data and consultant benchmarks.
s05.q3: What does the storytelling curriculum cover?
s05.a3: How to sequence a masterplan presentation: from Vision 2030 and regional infrastructure, to neighborhood amenities, to the unit's views, privacy setbacks and long-term value.
